name: SimpleMind
description_en:
SimpleMind is a mind-mapping application for free-form or automatically arranged topic structures. Pro adds richer styling, media and sharing capabilities, with separate platform purchases rather than a universal subscription.

Free mobile editions, desktop trials and paid Pro have different rights. Being able to open a map on several platforms does not mean one purchase licenses every platform.
description_zh:
SimpleMind 是支持自由或自动布局的脑图应用。Pro 增加样式、媒体和分享能力，按平台分别购买，而非通用订阅。

移动免费版、桌面试用和付费 Pro 权益不同。能在多个平台打开脑图，不代表一次购买授权所有平台。

core_features.explanation_en: Arrange topics manually or use automatic structure.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可手动放置主题或使用自动结构。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro adds media, notes, links and visual customization.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 添加媒体、笔记、链接及视觉定制。

core_features.explanation_en: Pro is purchased once per platform; bundles and user counts differ.
core_features.explanation_zh: Pro 按平台一次购买，组合及用户数不同。

zh: 示例：把阅读笔记整理成论点图
use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Limited Free mobile editions, 30-day desktop trial, one-time per-platform Pro; Mac/Windows single user US$29.99 excluding VAT.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 有受限移动免费版、30 天桌面试用及按平台一次购买 Pro；Mac/Windows 单用户 29.99 美元、不含 VAT。

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The homepage describes placing topics freely or choosing auto layouts, then adding color, images, notes, links and checkboxes in Pro. A mind map can show a hierarchy, but the relationships and wording remain the author’s responsibility. The feature page compares editions; text extraction does not reliably preserve every tick/cross, so do not assign all displayed features to Free.
sections.zh: 首页介绍自由放置主题或采用自动布局，并在 Pro 中添加颜色、图片、笔记、链接和复选框。脑图可展示层级，但关系及措辞仍由作者负责。功能页对照不同版本，文本提取无法可靠保留所有勾叉，不能把全部显示功能归给 Free。

sections.title_en: Example: turn reading notes into an argument map
sections.title_zh: 示例：把阅读笔记整理成论点图
sections.en: Create a central question, add claims as branches and attach notes identifying evidence or uncertainty. Move a subtopic when its parent changes, then inspect the layout and a PDF export from an eligible edition. Keep source references distinct from your interpretation. This is an editorial workflow, not a learning-retention experiment or an executed export.
sections.zh: 建立中心问题，把主张列为分支，在笔记中标记证据或不确定性。父级变化时移动子主题，再检查布局及有相应权益版本的 PDF 导出。来源引证应与个人解释区分。本例是编辑流程，不是记忆提升实验或实际导出测试。

sections.en: The Pro purchase page explicitly says no monthly or annual fee. It lists a single Mac or Windows user license at US$29.99 excluding VAT and a Mac+Windows combination at US$54.99. Family/team and larger licenses have separate counts and prices. Free is available on iPhone/iPad and Android with limited functionality; the full desktop trial lasts 30 days. Mobile store prices and eligibility need their own check, so no universal monthly amount is stored.
sections.zh: Pro 购买页明确无月费或年费，Mac 或 Windows 单用户许可为 29.99 美元、不含 VAT，Mac+Windows 组合为 54.99 美元。家庭团队及更大许可另有人数价格。iPhone/iPad 和 Android 有功能受限免费版，完整桌面试用为 30 天。移动商店价格及资格需另核，因此不存通用月价。

sections.title_en: Check platform, files and sharing expectations
sections.title_zh: 确认平台、文件及分享预期
sections.en: The purchase page lists macOS 12+, Windows 7+, iOS 15+ and Android 8+ as current requirements; verify the selected store build before installing. Start with a trial or appropriate Free edition and test your actual import/export and cross-device file route. SimpleMind may suit personal visual organization, while simultaneous team collaboration needs separate verification. Source licensing, sync conflict behavior and restoration remain unverified.
sections.zh: 购买页当前列 macOS 12+、Windows 7+、iOS 15+、Android 8+，安装前仍需确认所选商店版本。可从试用或相应免费版开始，测试实际导入导出和跨设备文件链路。它可能适合个人可视整理，同时团队协作则需另查。源码许可、同步冲突行为及恢复未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify mobile store prices, chosen platform license rights, sync/conflict handling, collaboration and exact import/export fidelity.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认移动商店价格、平台许可、同步冲突处理、协作及具体导入导出保真。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
